card.name: Linking words before erythromycin in inhibitor lists
card.fires_on: Commas, "and", "as" and "e.g." inside lists of moderate CYP3A inhibitors, just before the next drug such as verapamil or erythromycin. Also fires on "a" before a noun in a story.

modes.label: Inhibitor example lists
modes.description: Punctuation or linking words between drugs listed as CYP3A inhibitors, right before erythromycin or verapamil.
